key_highlights: ASX shed ~$90bn in a week as rate-rise fears and oil price surge pressured miners and banks
Iron ore entering a 'bloodletting' phase, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
AUD smashed on growth scare; oil 'exploded' as US-Iran conflict shows no end
RBA flagged rental inflation as a key concern, complicating rate path
Queensland credit rating downgraded for first time since 2009
Australia softened gas reservation rules, easing Asian supply fears; Santos preservation noted
Housing: high-end prices crashing while affordable segment resilient; first-home buyer surge
Fuel prices set to rise 30c/litre; Chinese inflation soaring
Small-cap miners (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka) and ASX runners (Iondrive, Aruma, Neurizon) showing relative strength

sectors.trend: Sharp negative. Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; oil surge benefits energy names but commodity complex is mixed. Small-cap explorers (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka, Kuniko, Gateway WA) showing relative outperformance. Canaccord-led cap raises signal capital-raising pressure.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face near-term downside on iron ore. Energy names (Santos, Woodside) supported by oil surge and gas policy easing. Small-cap gold/silver (Kuniko, Gateway WA) offer diversification but carry execution risk.

sectors.trend: Negative. Rising bond yields and rate fears pressure bank valuations. Queensland downgrade signals sovereign credit stress. Superannuation populism debate (One Nation) adds policy uncertainty.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from rate volatility. QLD downgrade may affect state-linked lending. Super policy risk is a medium-term overhang for fund managers.

sectors.trend: Strong positive. Oil 'exploded' on US-Iran conflict; fuel prices +30c. Australia's gas reservation easing supports domestic producers. ExxonMobil +40% YTD globally.
sectors.implications: Santos (STO.AX), Woodside (WDS.AX), Origin (ORG.AX) benefit from oil/gas tailwinds. Fuel cost pass-through pressures consumer staples and transport.

sectors.trend: Mixed-negative. Woolworths price-freeze breach erodes trust. Fuel cost rise squeezes household budgets. Business confidence deteriorating.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure from input costs. Defensive positioning warranted but consumer spending at risk.

sectors.trend: Negative. High-end housing prices crashing; RBA worried about rental inflation. Leith Van Onselen warns of further housing falls. First-home buyer surge is a bright spot.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) pressured by rental inflation and rate uncertainty. Housing correction may extend 6-12 months at the top end.

sectors.trend: Neutral-positive. CSL.AX and healthcare names (J&J, Pfizer globally) offer defensive appeal. ASX tech runners (Neurizon, Iondrive) show momentum. Apple foldable iPhone and Oracle earnings are global catalysts.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX provide portfolio ballast. Small-cap tech (Neurizon, Iondrive) speculative but momentum-driven.

key_themes: Oil price surge driven by US-Iran conflict; no resolution in sight
Iron ore structural decline pressuring ASX200 miners
AUD weakness on growth scare; rate differential narrowing
RBA caught between rental inflation and growth slowdown
Housing bifurcation: top-end crash vs affordable resilience
Queensland sovereign downgrade signals fiscal stress
Gas policy liberalisation supports domestic energy security
Superannuation policy debate (One Nation) creates regulatory uncertainty
Chinese inflation surge may slow commodity demand
Small-cap mining and tech showing relative strength vs large caps

risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; monitor OPEC+ response; consider oil-linked ETFs as tactical hedge
Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weightings; rotate into gold and energy

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate path uncertainty / rental inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour fixed-rate debt; monitor RBA statements; avoid rate-sensitive REITs short-term
Hedge AUD exposure; favour export-oriented earnings (mining, agribusiness)
Review QLD-linked infrastructure and state-guaranteed exposures
Avoid luxury REITs; monitor first-home buyer data for stabilisation signal
Monitor political risk; super fund managers (HUB.AX, PPA.AX) may face regulatory shifts

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy: Santos, Woodside, Origin on oil surge and gas policy easing
opportunities.rationale: Oil 'exploded' on US-Iran conflict; gas reservation liberalisation supports domestic producers; fuel +30c signals sustained pricing power

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical gold/silver exposure via small-cap explorers
opportunities.rationale: Gold 'schmould' at large-cap level but small-cap explorers (Kuniko, Gateway WA) show discovery momentum; AUD weakness supports gold
CSL.AX and SGH.AX offer earnings visibility amid market volatility; global healthcare rotation (J&J preferred over LLY/PFE)
Iondrive, Aruma, Neurizon, Australasian showing relative strength; speculative but momentum-driven in risk-off large-cap environment

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore exposure; trim BHP, RIO, FMG
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; Chinese inflation surge may cap demand; structural oversupply risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: De-risk rate-sensitive REITs and high-end property
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA rental inflation concern; top-end housing crash; further rate uncertainty

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness; favour export-earning names
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD 'smashed' on growth scare; export-oriented earnings benefit from weaker currency

defensive_moves.recommendation: Increase cash / short-duration bonds as buffer
defensive_moves.rationale: Late-stage bubble warning; $90bn ASX drawdown; oil-driven inflation may delay rate cuts

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to consolidate lower as oil-driven inflation keeps rate-cut expectations at bay. Iron ore weakness and AUD pressure cap upside. Energy and gold are relative outperformers. Expect volatility around US-Iran developments and RBA commentary.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Housing correction at top-end may stabilise within 6-12 months. Gas policy reform supports energy sector structurally. Small-cap innovation (battery tech, AI, biotech) offers asymmetric upside. Key risk: prolonged commodity downturn and Chinese demand weakness.
key_catalysts: US-Iran conflict resolution or escalation (oil price)
RBA next statement on rental inflation and rate path
Oracle and Apple earnings (global tech sentiment)
watch_list: RBA cash rate and rental inflation data
BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX – iron ore exposure
CBA.AX, NAB.AX – bank NIM and credit
Housing price indices (SQM, CoreLogic) – top vs bottom end
